title: Enforcement action record
description: One published enforcement action against an education and care service or approved provider, as parsed from an official register. One row per action per service. Person-level fields are never stored.

record_id.description: Stable hash of jurisdiction, the source document parsed and a hash of the row's full printed source text (every printed field, whitespace and case normalised), then an occurrence counter shared only by rows whose printed text is fully identical. No source-order ordinal and no published or withheld value is used; the printed text itself is never stored.

source_document.description: The page or file the row was parsed from.

source_snapshot.description: Path under data/raw/ of the snapshot parsed.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the snapshot was fetched.

provider_name.description: Legal or trading name of the approved provider entity. Never an individual.

action_type.description: Normalised category. Use 'other' and keep action_type_raw when unsure; never guess.

action_type_raw.description: Exactly as printed by the register.

reason.description: Reason text as printed. Free text. Must not contain individual names.

legal_references.description: Section and regulation numbers cited, as printed.

period_label.description: Register period the row came from, e.g. '2025 Q2' or 'August 2026'.

notes.description: Parser warnings: duplicate rows, unparsable dates, missing keys.
